description: You do not have to give everything 100% #PersonalGrowth #selfpresservation #DesignYourLife
transcript: You are not required to operate at full capacity at all times. Not everything requires 100%. Understand the roles that you play and stop allowing things that don't require all of you to drain you, to suck your energy. You are not required to be everything for everyone. Sometimes it's okay to sit in the back seat while others to drive.
